origin.description: Turn the short type name into the label shown above a column.
origin.usage:
format_type_sum(x, width, ...)

format_type_sum.default(x, width, ...)

format_type_sum.AsIs(x, width, ...)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The text returned by type_sum. An AsIs string is a type that should be shown without brackets.

arguments.name: width
arguments.text: The display width allowed for the label. NULL means do not cut the text. A budget that is too small trims the type before the brackets are added.
Further arguments passed to the method. A name that the method does not use warns.

origin.details: The default method wraps the text in angle brackets. The AsIs method, used for a value returned as I("type"), leaves the brackets off. Both then paint the label subtle and italic, with the italic codes outside the grey codes. Trimming uses the display width for the decision and code points for the cut. For the default method the cut length is max(width - 2, 0), because the two brackets take two columns. For AsIs the cut length is width.
origin.value: One styled string, or a character vector when x has several elements and width is NULL.

translation.description: The same label. AsIs is a string subclass. None is a missing type name and is shown as <NA>.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A string, None, an AsIs string, or a list of strings. AsIs prints without angle brackets.

arguments.name: width
arguments.text: None skips the cut. A number is the display width. The comparison uses display width and the cut uses code points.

translation.details: The label is style_subtle of the text, then italic wrapped around that whole string. With 8 colors, dbl and no width is italic open, grey open, <dbl>, grey close, italic close. width 4 cuts dbl to db because 4 - 2 is less than the display width 3, so the text is <db>. width 5 keeps <dbl>. A list and a width together is an error, because the decision has to be one true or false. An empty list with no width becomes a pair of brackets with nothing inside, since paste drops a zero-length argument. An AsIs string cut down to nothing is italic with nothing inside, and the grey is skipped because the empty string is left empty.
translation.value: A string for one type name, or a list when x is a list of type names.
translation.example:
from cli._options import options as cli_options

cli_options(**{"cli.num_colors": 8})

from pillar.styles import format_type_sum

print(format_type_sum("dbl", width=None))
